# Akroasis

> Signals-intelligence and communications-sovereignty workspace built around one typed signal model.

Akroasis unifies radio, mesh, SDR, proximity, network defense, OSINT, offensive security, geospatial, privacy, and interface domains by having each domain emit typed signals into shared foundations.

## Binary

`akroasis` - single CLI shell under `crates/akroasis`.

## Architecture

Structured LLM corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): current and planned layers and crates
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): phase and blockers
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted architecture decisions
- [_llm/glossary.toml](_llm/glossary.toml): akroasis vocabulary
- [_llm/apis.toml](_llm/apis.toml): current CLI surface

## Agent Entry Points

- [README.md](README.md): domain map and crate status
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): repo conventions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): cross-tool instructions
- [docs/lexicon.md](docs/lexicon.md): name registry
- [standards/](standards/): kanon-synced standards
